content: SheetJS 'xlsx' on public npm is stuck at 0.18.5 (4y old, unmaintained there, past CVEs GHSA prototype-pollution/ReDoS fixed only in >=0.19.3/0.20.2). Current is 0.20.3 distributed ONLY from cdn.sheetjs.com (npm i https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz). Reads legacy .xls (BIFF2-8), .xlsx, .xlsb, .ods in one API (XLSX.read(buf,{type:'buffer'})). exceljs 4.4.0 = xlsx-only (no .xls). node-xlsx 0.24.0 is a thin wrapper over SheetJS. For messy legacy .xls + .xlsx server-side, SheetJS 0.20.3 from CDN is the only real option.
